comments: cb555372: This program is used to delete incomplete patient records from the Veterans Affairs (VA) system.
819d8363: Start processing and exit if necessary conditions are not met.
53d4647a: Check if the division selection feature is enabled and prompt the user to select a division if it is.
feaf2e0e: Default to the first division if no division is selected/available.
6efbb0b5: Warn the user if the division parameters for delinquency tracking are not set up.
b67bf5f2: Filter selection of patient records to those belonging to the selected division.
c6eb13dd: Prompt the user to select a patient incomplete record for deletion.
0225caea: Set up variables for deletion and call the viewing logic to display the record.
2901b93c: Initialize variables for Ok to Delete functionality.
d6e048bd: Clear the return value of the list processor.
1476a057: Select entries from the list for processing.
db654961: Prepare the screen for a full view refresh upon return.
5191592e: Process each selected entry for deletion, invoking the edit screen for each.
8f2d8633: Return to the report screen upon completing the delete process.
5fd4514d: Prompt the user to confirm deletion of the patient incomplete record entry.
5cf47e51: If confirmed, delete the record and display a deletion message.
fe861dac: Exit the delete confirmation process if the user decides not to delete.
1aca1fcc: Set a flag to indicate the user is exiting the delete process.
2fd1b1c9: Clean up variables and exit the routine.
6f4260ce: Provide instructions for the Yes/No prompt.
